Member access policy

Access decisions pin token balance, Culture Account ownership, evolution, and credentials to one finalized NEAR block.

Passing members receive: community membership · Arena entry · gated drops · treasury proposals. Frozen Culture Accounts automatically lose utility while the NFT remains owned.
